p1: The note on my new fridge said: Leave a plate out every night. He gets hungry.
Mrs Doyle, the old owner, left it when she moved out.
I figured she meant a cat. So every night, I left leftovers on the counter.
Every morning, the plate was licked clean. But I never saw a cat. Not once.
At 3 a.m., something scratched at my bedroom door. Slowly.
I opened it. Down the hallway, the attic hatch was hanging open.
I climbed up with my phone light.
Plates. Dozens of them. Stacked in the dark, all licked clean.
Then, from behind the boxes, a man whispered...
I ran. The next day, my brother checked the attic. It was empty.
I'm moving out Saturday. Until then, I leave a plate out. And I lock my door.
